vintage: PKP PLK timetable via GTFS feed 2026-11-27; weekday 2026-12-16
rules: One ordinary Wednesday: the Wednesday in the published 30-day timetable with the most trains, outside public holidays and the Christmas and New Year period.
Every passenger train of every operator on the PKP PLK network that runs that day is shown; replacement buses are left out.
Night trains that leave the evening before are shown until they arrive that morning.
Between two stops a train moves along its route line at a steady speed and waits at each station for its timetabled stop.

attribution.processed: Converted from the GTFS feed for this map: one day kept, stations and route lines projected and simplified, train positions between stops interpolated.
